readout_other: EEG alpha and theta power at F8, frontal alpha asymmetry, reaction times in an emotional-faces internal shift task; BDI-V
direction_notes: litFUS to the right IFG altered the F8 alpha response in interaction with stimulus likelihood and attention focus; the overall alpha effect was negative in the full model but positive in a litFUS-only model.

exposures.label: litFUS to right IFG at F8

timing.protocol_description: Single 120 s sonication at the F8 position before the EEG task, once per session (litFUS in one session, sham in the other, seven days apart); no intervals or trains described.

source_quotes.n_subjects: the right inferior frontal gyrus (riFG) of 41 healthy participants was targeted
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: However, on one measurement occasion, participants received litFUS modulation while sham was applied in the remaining one.
